title: Lanthanum triflate catalysed acyl transfer from β-diketones to amines: conversion of aryl methyl ketones to amides
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29603-29610
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03708A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rajendra Prasad, Purnima Pradhan, Partha Ghosh
Lanthanum triflate was found to be an efficient catalyst for the amide formation through acyl transfer from β-diketones to amines overcoming the stable enamine formation pathway.
